headline: Medallia explores new growth funding round amid CX market consolidation
summary: Reports indicate Medallia is in early talks with investors for a new funding round as competition in the customer experience space intensifies. The move follows several smaller CX vendors being acquired over the past year.

headline: Qualtrics names new Chief Revenue Officer to lead global go-to-market
summary: Qualtrics announced a leadership change with a new CRO tasked with accelerating enterprise growth. The appointment signals a renewed push into international markets over the next fiscal year.

headline: New data privacy rules could reshape how CX platforms handle customer feedback
summary: Regulators in the EU proposed stricter consent requirements for survey and feedback data collection. Analysts expect CX platform vendors to accelerate compliance tooling over the coming quarters.

headline: Medallia launches AI-powered sentiment analysis for real-time agent coaching
summary: The new product uses generative AI to flag negative sentiment during live customer calls and suggest coaching prompts to agents. Early customers report faster resolution times in pilot programs.

headline: Qualtrics customers cite integration complexity as top pain point in recent survey
summary: A third-party buyer survey found that nearly 40% of Qualtrics customers struggle with integrating the platform into existing data stacks. The company is reportedly hiring additional solutions engineers to address onboarding friction.
